summary: Iteration 9 full-stack testing. BACKEND 100%: new iter9 suite 17/17 PASS (vision contract 400/404/auth; REAL OpenAI vision E2E on a generated weighment slip -> weight_kg=10000 & vehicle_number=MH12AB1234 exact; inward match/mismatch; plate normalization for spaces+case; weight-only mismatch; correction clears flag + history + role gating; still-mismatched keeps flag; outward flow; GET fields). FULL REGRESSION 153/153 PASS incl. the 2 previously-flaky tests (iter3 parties, iter7 FIFO) — flake fixes confirmed. FRONTEND: new theme verified (white surface, brand #3E8FD0 = rgb(62,143,208), zero orange leftovers); navigation login/home/inward/entries/inventory/entry-detail OK; entries list '⚠ SLIP' badge OK; entry detail red '⚠ SLIP MISMATCH — OFFICE REVIEW' banner (rgb(217,85,63)) with both human-readable detail lines OK; matched entry shows green 'SLIP OCR · Matches slip ✓' row OK; office weight-correction via UI recomputes flag + logs history OK. TWO frontend bugs found: (1) CRITICAL OCR integration bug — EntryForm sent JSON to the Form-only /vision/weight endpoint so in-app OCR ALWAYS failed (amber warning could never appear); I applied the minimal FormData fix and then verified the whole labour flow E2E (photo upload -> real OCR auto-fill 10000kg -> amber '⚠ Vehicle differs from slip' warning testID slip-mismatch-warning -> save NOT blocked -> entry persisted flagged with slip_ocr fields + photo). (2) HIGH — Hindi Poppins font never applies (React 19 removed defaultProps for function components; _layout.tsx mutates Text.defaultProps.style which is a no-op in react-native-web 0.21): all Devanagari text computes to '-apple-system...' system sans, no tofu but requirement unmet. (3) HIGH — correction form on entry detail lacks a vehicle_number input (corr-vehicle missing), so vehicle mismatches can never be cleared via UI even though backend PATCH supports vehicle_number and the banner instructs office to correct below.

ui_bugs.issue: pickPhoto called apiFetch('/vision/weight', body: JSON.stringify({slip_photo_path})) but backend declares slip_photo_path as Form(...) — JSON body returns 400 'Provide file or slip_photo_path', so OCR always failed in the real app (toast 'OCR skipped'), ocrWeight/ocrVehicle never set, amber warning unreachable. Verified RCA via curl: JSON->400, multipart->200 with correct weight+vehicle. Fixed by sending FormData. Reference: /app/frontend/src/screens/EntryForm.tsx:178

Hindi -> Poppins never applies: React 19.2.3 removed defaultProps for function components, so Text.defaultProps.style / TextInput.defaultProps.style mutation is a no-op with react-native-web 0.21 function components. Measured computed fontFamily of Devanagari text on login (after toggle), home (after toggle), and home/inward mounted fresh under lang=hi — always '-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, ...sans-serif', never Poppins. Glyphs render via browser fallback (no tofu) but requirement is unmet. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:23-36

No vehicle_number correction input (no corr-vehicle testID) although CorrectionUpdate supports vehicle_number and the mismatch banner says 'Correct the entry below — the flag clears automatically'. Verified via UI: weight-only correction cleared the weight detail but 'Vehicle differs from slip' persists with no UI remedy — office cannot clear vehicle mismatches without API calls. Reference: /app/frontend/app/entry/[id].tsx:253-262

rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (fixed): Frontend POSTed JSON {slip_photo_path} with Content-Type application/json; FastAPI Form(...) params parse only multipart/urlencoded, so both optional form fields were None -> 400 'Provide file or slip_photo_path'. OCR silently skipped via toast; slip cross-check state never populated; feature unreachable in-app. Mitigation applied: multipart FormData body (apiFetch already skips JSON content-type for FormData). Repro: labour inward -> pick slip photo -> (before fix) weight never auto-fills. BUG 2 (reported): React 19 removed defaultProps for function components; react-native-web Text/TextInput are function components, so FontDefaults' Text.defaultProps.style assignment never applies -> both EN and HI render in the web default sans stack. Repro: toggle हिंदी, inspect any Devanagari element's computed fontFamily. BUG 3 (reported): correction UI never rendered a vehicle input though the backend contract supports it — incomplete form mapping in entry/[id].tsx.
